meta.title: ProjectColourPaletteView
meta.description: Static reference data — not built from any event. The fixed, ordered 6-colour palette every project is drawn from. Source of truth for: (1) the swatch order shown on the Create Project screen, (2) what 'Next colour' cycles through, and (3) the default auto-suggestion, which is the first palette entry not already present in ProjectRosterView.colour.
